The Taking of Deborah Logan - 5/5 Incredible acting and atmosphere.

End of the Line - 4.5/5 Holy mother of jumpscares. A thrilling ride from beginning to end. Horrible acting though.

Creep (2004) - 2.5/5 Honestly the only reason I watched this is because I mistook it for the next movie. Whatever. Still had me entertained though.

Creep (2014) - 3.5/5 Its kind of boring but I liked the acting. The latter half of the movie could have been fleshed out a bit meaningfully.

Silent House - 2.5/5 This movie was so insipid.

V/H/S 2 - 5/5 I found it a very scary and wild ride despite popular opinion.

Deliver Us From Evil - 2.5/5 I suppose Eric Bana is getting desperate. Pity because I really wanted to like this one

Silent Hill: Revelation - 0.5/5 Talk about taking a very watery shit on an excellent first movie. Avoid this one like AIDS. Seriously, there's absolutely NOTHING to see here.

Open Grave - 3/5 Decent plot marred by a dumb ending. Keeps you guessing.

La Horde (French) - 2/5 Dawn of the Dead this isn't but it tries to be. Had a single scene that was pretty good and ambitious if only it kept up that pace.

Antiviral - 2.5/5 Had a great atmosphere and is well-shot ridiculous plot aside.

Contracted - 2.5/5 I'd say its decent. Not too scary but rather revolting.

Cheap Thrills - 4/5 Most entertaining out of the whole 'do nasty shit for money' genre.

13 Sins - 3/5 Lesser than Cheap Thrills.

Would You Rather - 2/5 Lesser than 13 Sins.

Rigor Mortis (Chinese) - 2/5 What the fuck was that all about? Well I know it had something to do with a previous series but I can only speak from an outsider's perspective seeing how it is a homage to Hong Kong movies or something. The visual effects were decent but cheesy.

Oculus - 3/5 I don't get it. I wasn't scared and found the plot weak. I think the movie failed at making me want to care.

The Sacrament - 3.5/5 Entertaining watch although nothing to write home about.

As Above, So Below - 2/5 I really wanted to like this and it had things going for it until it broke down into cheap B-movie crap.

Starry Eyes - 3.5/5 Very refreshing with a nice twist.

Extraterrestrial 1.5/5 Move along folks. Nothing to see here.

Monsters - 0.5/5 Self-indulgent snoozefest. I don't see any reason why this is praised so highly.

Resolution - 4.5/5 Weird and entertaining with one hell of a gripping plot.

The Descent - 4.9/5 Nothing needs to be said more about this movie at this point.

The Descent 2 - 3/5 A crushing downgrade.

The Road (Pinoy) - 2/5 Had to check out what the hype was. Too drawn-out and had very mild-mannered scares with an oafish twist at the end.

Tucker and Dale vs Evil - 3.5/5 Not a particular fan of horror-comedies. But was funny.

Ritual/Modus Anomali (Indonesian) - 2.75/5 Don't watch if you're impatient. Liked the atmosphere even though most of it was quite ham-fisted.

Kill List - 3/5 Decent atmosphere and acting. Kind of reminded me of A Serbian Film.

POV: Norowareta firumu (Japanese) - 3/5 I'm lukewarm towards this. Might be scarier for younger folks. (I'm 27 for anyone wondering)

Last Summer (Thai) - 2.5/5 It's like a super-fun rollercoaster that is fun for exactly 10 minutes or so.

Altered - 2.5/5 Ignore the hype. This turned out to be quite boring.

Maniac - 3.5/5 Frodo does a convincing serial killer.

The Pact - 2/5 Terribly boring. Was such a chore to watch. Clichés abound with a twist that insults the intelligence of the viewers.

Afflicted - 3.5/5 It was original for sure. Could have done so much more with it.

The Borderlands - 4/5 Totally enjoyable. Had a few good scares and I really dug the eeriness.

The Battery - 3/5 Fantastic movie if they could reduce it by an hour. I mean sure it's supposed to be artistic but I'd rather not watch two guys brush their teeth for an extended period.
